answer_1.quote: We evaluate on multilingual (extractive) question answering, visual question answering, maths (GSM8K) and coding (HumanEval), as well as open‑ended generation (AlpacaEval, SeqEval).
answer_1.outputs: answers to QA, generated code, generated captions, translated text, reasoning steps

answer_2.quote: We report ROUGE‑L (R‑L) and BERTScore (BS) on the repeated content and human‑counted success rate (%). We also use accuracy, pass@10, and LLM‑as‑a‑judge scores.

answer_3.quote: We use GPT‑4‑Turbo to directly score the quality of each model response on a scale of 1 to 5 and also ask the judge LLM to produce a binary judgement of whether all questions are fulfilled.

answer_4.quote: We also use human inspection or GPT‑4‑Turbo to verify if a model follows all instructions, reporting a human‑counted success rate.
answer_4.guideline: Human annotators count whether the model fulfills all tasks/instructions in the query.
